description: This file defines a REST API controller for managing vacancy listings in the Recruitment module of OrangeHRM. It handles HTTP GET requests to retrieve a list of vacancies, including filtering, pagination, and sorting options, leveraging various services and data transfer objects. The controller implements interface methods for other HTTP verbs but currently throws not implemented exceptions for POST, PUT, and DELETE operations.

classes.name: VacancyListRestController
classes.description: A REST API controller responsible for handling vacancy listing requests in the Recruitment module, supporting pagination, filtering, and sorting.

methods.name: handleGetRequest
methods.description: Processes GET requests to retrieve a list of vacancy models, applying filters and sorting, and returning a normalized response with total count.

methods.name: handlePostRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating POST requests are not supported.

methods.name: getNotImplementedException
methods.description: Returns a NotImplementedException instance for unsupported HTTP methods.

methods.name: handlePutRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating PUT requests are not supported.

methods.name: handleDeleteRequest
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating DELETE requests are not supported.

methods.name: initGetValidationRule
methods.description: Initializes validation rules for GET query parameters like limit, offset, and sort order.

methods.name: getValidationDecorator
methods.description: Lazy initializes and returns the ValidationDecorator used for request validation.

methods.name: initPostValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating POST validation rules are not implemented.

methods.name: initPutValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating PUT validation rules are not implemented.

methods.name: initDeleteValidationRule
methods.description: Throws NotImplementedException, indicating DELETE validation rules are not implemented.
